extracted.intended_audience: CIA senior managers and staff responsible for preparing the Agency's Annual Management Improvement Report to OMB (compliance with OMB Circular A-44)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the Agency Annual Management Improvement Report required by OMB Circular A-44, including assigning responsibility, assembling required sections (agency review policy, performance reviews, cost-reduction accomplishments), and coordinating verification and priorities across directorates.

rubrics_metrics.name: A-44 reporting deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The Annual Management Improvement Report required by OMB under OMB Circular A-44 is due 1 September 1973.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain issuance of instructions soon to meet the deadline; memo notes the International Programs Division at OMB might not be disturbed if the report slipped a week or two.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation to a top-level official
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency Head should delegate responsibility for the whole broad management improvement program to one 'top-level official reporting directly to the Department or Agency Head.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Last year this was the Executive Director-Comptroller; absence of such an official requires identifying an alternative authoritative designee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment of authoritative responsibility (single individual vs deputies)
rubrics_metrics.description: If organizational problems make it impossible to assign authoritative, agency-wide management review and improvement responsibility to a single individual, the alternative is to assign responsibility to each Deputy Director for activities under his command.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide whether to request each Deputy Director to submit a full A-44 response (including Agency review policy section) and determine who (e.g., D/PPB, DD/M&S, or other) initiates the call and who overviews the overall effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspector General responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Inspector General had responsibility for the articulation of Agency management review policy and for conducting organizational performance reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include Inspector General input on review policy and performance-review findings in the Agency report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directorates' reporting responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Directorates are responsible for reporting management improvement, productivity, and cost reduction accomplishments and for planning and reporting upcoming efforts in those areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directorates must document past accomplishments and planned efforts in management improvement, productivity, and cost reduction for inclusion in the Agency submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reports reduction program
rubrics_metrics.description: A reports reduction program was identified and assigned (subject in memo omitted), implying responsibility for reducing reporting burdens and documenting that program's progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the reports reduction program's status, accomplishments, and planned actions are captured in the A-44 report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of Finance – financial management improvements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Finance is responsible for reporting specific financial management improvements achieved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The A-44 response should include specific financial management improvements attributable to the Office of Finance.

rubrics_metrics.name: PPB coordination and report production
rubrics_metrics.description: PPB (Planning, Programming, and Budgeting) had the responsibility, as an operating arm of the Executive Director-Comptroller, to coordinate and produce the Agency report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designate a coordinating office (e.g., PPB) to gather inputs, assemble the Agency report, and manage submission logistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required Agency review policy section
rubrics_metrics.description: The A-44 response must include an Agency review policy section articulating Agency-wide management review policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the Agency lacks a single authoritative official, decide which office compiles the Agency review policy section and ensure each deputy's inputs are incorporated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Areas requiring continuous oversight: records management, reports reduction, ADP improvements
rubrics_metrics.description: Circular A-44 refers to ongoing oversight for records management, reports reduction, and ADP (automated data processing) improvements as part of management improvement responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify who will overview these areas on a continuing basis and include status and plans for records management, reports reduction, and ADP improvements in the report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishing priorities and verifying claimed improvements/cost reductions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency must establish priority efforts and verify the claims for improvement and cost-reductions submitted in the A-44 report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set procedures for prioritization and for verification of improvement/cost-reduction claims (e.g., evidence standards, validation responsibilities) and document verification in the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determine initiating authority and oversight for Agency-wide effort
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify who initiates the call for submissions (D/PPB, DD/M&S, or other) and who overviews the whole Agency effort on a continuing basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify initiation and oversight roles to avoid 'management diffusion' and ensure coherent, authoritative Agency responses to Circular A-44.
